places.name: Magongawon Falls — Forest Trail
places.location: Tagbaobo, Kaputian District, Island Garden City of Samal
places.coordinate_role: Mapped service-road endpoint adjoining the walking trail; not the waterfall itself
places.description: Short forest hike down to Magongawon (Tagbaobo) Falls and back uphill. Steep, uneven and slippery sections make this different from a paved park walk. The itinerary location is the mapped road endpoint where walking begins.
places.planning_notes: An August 2026 visitor account reports PHP 30 admission; an earlier 2026 guide lists free entry. Budget-Friendly is inferred from these reports, not a verified all-in price. Confirm current admission, any guide requirement, environmental fees and return local transport before visiting. Road travel ends at the mapped trail start; descend and return on foot within the visit slot. Hours and full visit duration are unverified. Heavy rain can make the trail slippery and the water turbid; confirm conditions locally. No swimming, meal service or direct jeep service is promised.

evidence.supports: Recent forest hike, local vehicle access and reported PHP 30 admission; not an operator tariff.
Tagbaobo alias and steep forest approach; descent-only time is not recorded as full visit duration. Its free-entry and 24-hour claims are not adopted.
